From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Executive intro + demo slot for Innovatica pilot

Hi Maya — great to reconnect.

Thanks again for the warm intro to the Innovatica team. We’re excited to run the pilot and want to make sure the right leadership is present for the initial demo so we can align on success metrics and rollout constraints up front. Two asks:

1) Are you able to confirm whether Hector (CIO) or a VP-level sponsor can join a 30-minute demo? If Hector can’t make the full demo, would a short 10–15 minute intro from him plus a VP delegation work?

2) Suggested slots (PT):
   - Tue Apr 11 — 10:00–10:30 AM
   - Wed Apr 12 — 1:00–1:30 PM

We can also do a 15-minute pre-brief immediately before the demo to cover success criteria and security needs. I’ve looped Kim (solutions) to cover architecture and Ben for exec alignment.

Attached: prod-demo-deck.pdf (preview), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (draft).

If those times don’t work, please propose two alternatives next week and we’ll prioritize.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]
[Attachment: prod-demo-deck.pdf (PDF, 8MB)]
[Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)]

Date: Fri, 6 Apr 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive intro + demo slot for Innovatica pilot

Jordan — thanks for sending and for laying out the ask. Quick update on availability: Hector is traveling on Apr 11 and won’t be in a position to join live. He did ask that we prioritize a short CTO/VP level intro prior to the demo so he can watch the recording and sign off afterward.

Two options that would work for us (PT):
 - Mon Apr 10 — 3:30–4:00 PM
 - Tue Apr 11 — 9:00–9:30 AM (Hector not on call; VP-level sponsor will be present)

We’d prefer the Apr 11 morning slot if you can shift earlier. Also:
 - Can you send a 20-minute executive pre-brief (call) the same morning, we’d like to run through security assumptions and the minimum viable deliverables for the pilot.
 - Please include any SOC2 / compliance summary you have — our security team will review and may follow up.

I can confirm attendees once I get the calendar invite.

—Maya
Maya Randle
Director of Strategic Partnerships | Innovatica
[maya.randle@innovatica.com]
